helpTopics.title: Choosing stages
helpTopics.keywords: order dependency prerequisites select decode states
helpTopics.answer: The dashboard initially selects all eleven stages. Core stages cover screening through activity; the command-line runner uses those five by default. A partial run needs its earlier stages' caches.

helpTopics.title: Null shuffles through time
helpTopics.answer: The example uses 100 null estimates and exactly one observed estimate. Labels are shuffled independently at each bin by default. Preserve null time structure reuses each permutation and its inner folds across bins; models are fitted separately, and permutations remain independent between held-out trials.

helpTopics.title: What does calibrated confidence mean?
helpTopics.keywords: probability logistic_calibration_method logistic_calibration_cv sigmoid isotonic classifier_c grid_search_for_c sklearn reference
helpTopics.answer: The example fits logistic regression and sigmoid calibration using held-out inner-fold predictions, then evaluates one untouched outer test trial. C is selected before calibration, not separately inside every calibration fold. Screening and cue selection use the full session, so performance is conditional on those choices.

helpTopics.title: Read decoding scores correctly
helpTopics.keywords: evaluate accuracy brier log loss probability positive preferred class calibration reference
helpTopics.answer: Only preferred-cue trials are tested. Accuracy is the fraction with predicted probability at least 0.5; it is a positive-class hit rate, not balanced two-class accuracy. Lower Brier score and log loss indicate better probability scores on those trials, but do not establish calibration across both classes.

helpTopics.title: What do ON and OFF labels establish?
helpTopics.keywords: states z_threshold_on z_threshold_off cc_alpha_on cc_alpha_off cluster significance absence information
helpTopics.answer: ON and OFF are operational labels from confidence thresholds and cluster rules. OFF does not prove that information is absent. The OFF rule pools null cluster masses rather than using the ON maximum-mass rule; neither the alternative null time setting nor the alpha value alone establishes error control for the whole pipeline.

helpTopics.title: Interpret model validation and uncertainty
helpTopics.keywords: models mixedlm statsmodels cv_shuffles cv_holdout_fraction significance_alpha inference_valid rank_eligible p values reference
helpTopics.answer: The example repeats 20% within-session holdouts 50 times and reports both fixed-effect-only predictions and predictions that include fitted training-session intercepts. These holdouts do not measure prediction for new sessions or future trials. Check inference_valid and rank_eligible: a usable point prediction can coexist with unavailable coefficient uncertainty.

helpTopics.title: A fresh run or a rerun?
helpTopics.keywords: cache resume checkpoint folder overwrite history
helpTopics.answer: Use a new run directory when comparing analysis settings. Reusing a directory can replace stage outputs; manifest history is retained. Decoder checkpoints are reused only when their inputs and settings match.

helpTopics.title: Keep a reusable configuration
helpTopics.keywords: preset settings json save export import
helpTopics.answer: The form starts with the example settings. Copy settings from the JSON editor into a named configuration file, or use Reuse settings from a previous run.

helpTopics.title: Warnings and failed stages
helpTopics.keywords: error missing invalid failure help troubleshooting
helpTopics.answer: Open the stage log for the specific message. A completed pipeline can still contain model warnings or unavailable results; inspect fit diagnostics before interpreting them.

helpTopics.title: Export clear figures
helpTopics.keywords: pdf png tif eps vector lossless formats
helpTopics.answer: Choose PNG for inline previews and PDF for vector text and paths. The format selection applies to every stage; embedded images remain raster data inside a PDF.

helpTopics.title: Sessions and available data
helpTopics.keywords: data directory allowlist missing session list file
helpTopics.answer: The session list filters the files actually present in your data directory. Listed sessions without matching files are reported; available listed sessions continue.

helpTopics.title: Compare with the right context
helpTopics.keywords: compare split screen session run results settings
helpTopics.answer: Keep the analysis population, preferred cue, trial set, and preprocessing in view. Different settings can change what a figure or score represents.
